Look at the rot eating away at our society. On Tuesday, 24 March 2026, during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition, new details brought to light in Parliament directly linked South African actress Terry Pheto to the staggering R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe. 

This is the inevitable consequence of a culture that has abandoned duty, honesty, and respect for the rule of law. While hard-working citizens are expected to show personal responsibility, the privileged few treat public funds like their own personal piggy banks, looting institutions like the National Lotteries Commission (NLC) for self-enrichment. This elite greed comes at the direct expense of vulnerable groups who bear the brunt of their selfishness. We do not need more progressive excuses or institutional decay; we need basic moral accountability, respect for authority, and a firm return to the foundational principles of community stewardship that keep a nation from rotting from the top down.
